text: 你转身离开，并把门关在身后。你朝楼梯下方望去，意识到自己并非独自一人。约书亚堵在入口处，脸涨得通红，怒不可遏。他右手拿着枪，迅速举枪对准你。
你只有一瞬间可以扑倒在地，之后他就会扣下扳机。也许你的反应够快。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 140
text: You turn around and leave the door closed behind you. Looking down the stairs, you realize that you are not alone. Dominating the entryway is Joshua, red-faced and furious. He has a gun in his right hand, which he quickly aims in your direction.
You have just a second to hit the ground before he pulls the trigger. Perhaps your reflexes are quick enough.
